 
PRIVATE MEMBERS’ MOTIONS 
 
The Assembly resumed the adjourned debate on the proposed Motion No. 1 moved by Ms. Eagles: 
 
That this Assembly supports this government’s commitment to the Boundary Dam Integrated Carbon 
capture and sequestration project. This innovative facility is the first of its kind and is a tangible step 
in addressing the production of greenhouse gases worldwide. Further its innovative technology 
supports Saskatchewan’s resource industry which is vital to the prosperity of our province. 
 
The debate continuing, the Speaker interrupted proceedings pursuant to Rule 27(4) and put the question, 
which was agreed to on the following Recorded Division: 
 
YEAS – 39
